messages:
Maya: Heads-up — my flight landed late, I need to swap out of primary for tonight's 18:00-02:00 window. Current plan was me primary, Aj secondary. Can someone pick up primary starting ~18:15?
Aj: I can take 18:15-22:00 if that helps. I'm remote but available. Do you want me to update the rota? :+1:
Maya: thanks Aj. I still need a shadow for 22:00-02:00 — Luca or Katie, can either of you cover shadow/secondary for the late slot?
Luca: I can do 22:00-02:00 but heads-up I have a 23:00-23:30 meeting. Happy to cover except that 30m — Katie, would you be OK being active pager for that interval?
Katie: Yep I can pick up 23:00-23:30. I have KMS/devbox access and the runbook bookmarked.
Maya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-primary — see section "Paging & Escalation" and section 3 for fallbacks. Also a quick rotation snippet to apply to the calendar: 
```
rotation:
  primary: aj
  secondary: katie
  shadow: luca
  window: 18:15-02:00
```
Aj: I'll update the calendar and post an arrival note. I'll also set a short sync at 18:10 in #eng-oncall for a quick handover. @IncidentBot please lock coverage from 18:15 for Aj and assign pager.
IncidentBot: Coverage locked by Aj for 18:15-22:00 — pager reassigned to @Aj. :white_check_mark:
Maya: quick customer-impact context: earlier today we saw a burst of 500ms errors on embed endpoints during an autoscaling window; I applied a throttle and warmed KV caches. No ongoing customer-facing degradation, but please watch error-rate >0.5% and token latency on region-us-central for 2h.
Aj: I'll add a temporary alert: error_rate(embed_service) > 0.5% for 5m -> pager. Which grafana dashboard do you want monitored?
Maya: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/serving — check panel "embed error rate" and "token p50/p95". If we see latency increase, fallback flow is quantized variant per runbook (section 3).
Luca: noted — I'll verify KV cache hit-rates at 22:00 handoff and post status. If warm-up needs help, we'll trigger a small burst of synthetic requests (see runbook snippet).
Katie: I'll be on pager 23:00-23:30 and can escalate to platform if needed. I also have access to the Dedicated pool dashboard.
Aj: confirmed. I'll post a 22:00 handoff message to say primary->shadow swap complete and include any outstanding action items. Thanks everyone for the quick shuffle :rocket:
Maya: thanks all — logging off now. One last note: if there's a capacity spike we should toggle fallback-models/quantize-mode before scaling to avoid long queue growth (runbook section 3.2). Please ack here when you see the calendar/incidentbot changes.
